description: HTML source for a web-based database visualization interface, including styling and client-side scripts for dynamic database, table, and data viewing.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and inserts an HTML table from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates a table cell with value, handling objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long texts or objects.
